_note: Technical Papers series. Add a paper: write _content/<slug>.md (start at '## Abstract'; no title or author lines), add an entry at the END of 'papers' with the next number, then run: python3 papers/_build.py. Never reuse a number or slug.

papers.title: Exoskeletons: History, Commercialisation, Industry Landscape and Future Outlook
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: From Yagn's 1890 spring patent and GE's Hardiman to FDA-cleared walking suits, factory shoulder vests and consumer hip-assist devices: the history, the path to market, today's major makers with links, and where each application is heading.

papers.title: Heat Sealing of LDPE, HS-BOPP, PET/LDPE, PET/MPET/LDPE and BOPP/MBOPP Laminates in Bag-Making Machines: Parameter Windows, Machine Evolution and Future Benchmarks
papers.author: K Vijay Anand
papers.summary: Starting jaw temperature, dwell and pressure for five common bag and pouch structures across their thickness ranges, why a PET outer layer doubles the sealing window, how bag-making machines evolved from cams to servo, today's speed benchmarks, and what recyclable mono-material films will change. PDF in IEEE two-column format.
